remarks: Welcome to this meticulously maintained, sun-filled, move-in-ready home. It offers modern updates throughout, a prime, walkable neighborhood, and a coveted location in the highly desirable Williamsville School District. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with a striking matte black backsplash that nicely complements the quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and white cabinetry. Ample counter and cabinet space makes this an enjoyable space to cook and entertain (2023). The bathrooms are updated; the 2nd-floor full bath was completely gutted and beautifully designed with a spectacular tile wall, double undermount sinks, granite counter, a deep soaking tub, a linen closet, and a wired music system (2020). You will find laminate and LVL flooring throughout most of this sensational home (LVL 1st floor, including baseboards 2020), and neutral wall-to-wall carpet (2022). This familiar floor plan offers great space for entertaining and comfortable everyday living.  The convenience of an attached garage and easy access from the glass doors seamlessly leads from the dining/kitchen areas to the generous, private, fully fenced (fence 2026) backyard. The deck offers a great place to relax and entertain, complete with a retractable awning and a pergola. The dry basement has a bonus finished living space (24x11) and was drywalled in (2016).  Additional updates include a Guardian, Hi-Efficiency furnace and deck paint (2026), beautiful interior 2-panel doors (2020), Vinyl Siding and California Closets (2017), architectural roof 2016 ), recessed lighting, new lighting fixtures throughout, vinyl windows, and a water backup sump pump for added peace of mind. There is so much to see in this wonderful home. This is the home you have been waiting for; and it is ready for you to settle in and enjoy. Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity to own in Williamsville! Offers are due Monday, 10/19 @ noon
